ULTLS.Tip.Sample: Add your own tips on the "Lore & Game Tips" tab to replace this sample line.
ULTLS.Overlay.SoundHint: Click anywhere to turn the sound on
ULTLS.Hub.MenuHint: Every setting for ULT's Loading Screen lives in one window: visibility, scenes, timing, layout, typography, palette, media, sound, tips, presets and conflict handling, with a live preview.
ULTLS.Hub.Title: ULT's Loading Screen — Hub
ULTLS.Hub.NoFilePicker: The file picker is unavailable in this Foundry version. Type the path manually.
ULTLS.Hub.ModuleHub: Open in Module Hub (install the Module Hub to use this)
ULTLS.Hub.Home.About: Built for visuals and atmosphere first — the loading screen is only on screen for a few seconds, but it can still feel like part of the story. Nearly every setting here exists to be pushed: colours, fonts, icon motion, layout zones, a custom background. Found something broken, or have an idea worth adding? Report it on GitHub — the link sits in the bottom-right corner.
ULTLS.Hub.Home.Intro: This is the control room for the loading screen. Every tab on the left holds one group of settings, and the panel above always shows what the current settings look like in practice — nothing here needs a world reload to preview, only some settings need one to actually apply (marked with a reload icon in the bottom-left corner once you change them).
ULTLS.Hub.Home.Hint: Start with Palette to pick a theme, then Layout & style to adjust the shape and position, then Background & icon for artwork. Scenes and Conflicts are there for when you need them, not by default.
ULTLS.Hub.Sound.Empty: No sound file chosen yet. Pick an audio file above to add a loading sound.
ULTLS.Hub.Sound.EmptyPlayer: The Game Master has not set a loading sound.
ULTLS.Hub.Sound.Note: Web browsers only allow sound after someone has clicked, tapped or pressed a key on the page — a browser rule that no module can bypass. Until then the loading screen shows a small "Click anywhere to turn the sound on" hint, and the sound starts with the first click. The Foundry desktop app has no such limit.
ULTLS.Hub.Tips.SecondsHint: Display time in seconds. Leave empty to use the default time.
ULTLS.Hub.Tips.Empty: No tips yet. Add your own, or use the buttons above to add a few ready-made ones.
ULTLS.Hub.Presets.Intro: A preset is a file holding all your settings and tips. Keep one as a backup, or share it with another world or another Game Master.
ULTLS.Hub.Presets.ExportText: Writes every setting of this module, and your tips, into one file. Scene rules are not included, because scene ids differ from world to world.
ULTLS.Hub.Presets.ImportText: Choose a preset file, or paste its text below. You will see a summary before anything changes.
ULTLS.Hub.Presets.ErrorFormat: This is not an ULT's Loading Screen preset.
ULTLS.Hub.Presets.ErrorJson: The text could not be read. It should be the full contents of a preset file.
ULTLS.Hub.Presets.ResetText: Puts every setting back to its starting value, including the scene rules. Your tips are kept unless you tick the box next to the button.
ULTLS.Menu.Tips.Intro: Tips are shown under the loading progress: your own lines, game hints, anything you like. Each tip can have its own display time.
ULTLS.Menu.Tips.Hint: Empty tips are ignored. Changes save automatically a moment after you stop typing. Paste several lines into one box to split them into separate tips.
ULTLS.Menu.Tips.SeedHint: Each click adds {count} random tips you do not have yet — nothing existing is overwritten. Click again for more, and edit or delete any line afterwards.
ULTLS.Menu.Scenes.Intro: Tick the scenes where the loading screen should appear. Usually just one — a title menu or an opening scene.
ULTLS.Menu.Scenes.NoScenes: There are no scenes in this world yet.
ULTLS.Menu.Scenes.Hint: An empty list shows the screen everywhere — safer than never showing it at all.
ULTLS.Notify.Conflict: ULT's Loading Screen: another loading screen module is active ({modules}). Both are trying to draw the same overlay.
ULTLS.Notify.ConflictDisabled: ULT's Loading Screen disabled itself because of a module conflict: {modules}
ULTLS.Notify.SafetyClosed: ULT's Loading Screen hit its safety timeout and closed itself.
ULTLS.Notify.TipsSeedNone: All ready-made tips of this kind are already in your list.
ULTLS.Notify.TipsDelayApplied: Display time set to {seconds} s for {count} tips.
ULTLS.Notify.PresetCopyFailed: The clipboard is not available, so the preset was saved to a file instead.
ULTLS.Notify.LegacyActive: An old copy of this module ("{id}") is still enabled next to the new one. Disable it in Manage Modules — the module now uses the id ult-ls.
ULTLS.Notify.Migrated: Copied {count} settings from the old module id. Reload the world to use them.
ULTLS.Personal.MenuHint: Choose your own look for the loading screen — colours, fonts, progress style and icon. It works only while the Game Master allows it, and it changes only your own screen.
ULTLS.Personal.Title: ULT's Loading Screen — My theme
ULTLS.Personal.Intro: Here you can give the loading screen your own look. Only you will see it — everyone else keeps the look the Game Master chose. Anything you do not change follows the Game Master's settings.
ULTLS.Personal.Allowed: The Game Master has allowed personal themes. Changes are saved on this device and used the next time the loading screen appears.
ULTLS.Personal.NotAllowed: The Game Master has not allowed personal loading themes in this world. The loading screen uses the look they chose.
ULTLS.Personal.GMNotice: You are the Game Master: the look of the loading screen for the whole world is set in the main Hub (the "Open Hub" button in the module settings). This window is for players.
ULTLS.Personal.Reset: Back to the Game Master's look
ULTLS.Personal.Note: Your choices apply to your own loading screen only. If the Game Master turns personal themes off, the world's look is used again — your choices are kept for when they are switched back on.
ULTLS.Changelog.Dismiss: Don't show until the next update
ULTLS.Changelog.DismissedNote: Got it. This window will stay away until the next update of the module.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_1.Title: a sound fix
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_1.Item.01: Sound: browsers only allow sound after a click, tap or key press. While it is blocked, the loading screen now shows a small "Click anywhere to turn the sound on" hint, and the sound starts with the first click.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_1.Item.02: Sound: on touch screens the very first tap now starts the sound; it used to need a second one.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Title: the Hub update
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.01: One settings window: the Hub replaces the long settings list with tabs, search and a live preview.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.02: Five themes — Idaris, Monochrome, Fantasy, Dark Fantasy and Sci-Fi — set colours, fonts and the progress style in one click.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.03: Fonts: separate settings for the main text and for the tips — family (from Foundry's own fonts), size, weight and italics.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.04: Icon: size, X/Y offset, endless rotation and pulse.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.05: A new progress style, a dashed trail with a travelling spark — five styles in total.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.06: Tips: 25 atmospheric lines and 15 Foundry tips, added four at a time at random.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.07: Tips: a separate display time for each tip, or one delay for all of them at once.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.08: Tips can use the same seven screen zones as the progress element, and merge into one box when they share a zone.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.09: Sound: your own audio file, with volume, fade-in and fade-out.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.10: Presets: export all settings to a file, import them back, or reset to defaults.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.11: Personal theme: if the Game Master allows it, each player can choose their own look for the loading screen.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.12: Loading stages now vary between a few different phrasings.
ULTLS.Changelog.1_4_0.Item.13: Fixes: the toolbox buttons work in Foundry 13 and 14, simple mode is available to players, and the slow-scene loading screen works after joining. The module id is now ult-ls — settings from the old ult-ld are copied automatically, and the old copy can be removed.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Atmospheric.01: Gathering the threads of the story.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Atmospheric.05: Counting the coins in the party's purse.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Atmospheric.06: Waking the dice from their slumber.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Atmospheric.10: Reading between the lines of an ancient tome.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Atmospheric.14: Listening for footsteps in the dark.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Atmospheric.18: Sorting loot by rarity, and by regret.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Atmospheric.19: Rolling for initiative behind the scenes.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Atmospheric.23: Brewing tension for the next encounter.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Atmospheric.25: Setting the stage for what comes next.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.01: Hold Alt while dropping an actor onto the canvas to place a hidden token.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.02: Right-click a token to open its HUD, or hover over it and press T to target it.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.03: Hold Ctrl and drag across the canvas to measure a distance with the ruler.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.04: Compendium entries can be dragged straight onto the canvas or a sheet.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.05: Ctrl+Z undoes your last canvas action — Foundry keeps a short history.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.06: Map notes pin a journal entry to a spot on the scene, so the story lives on the map itself.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.07: Type /r 1d20 in chat to roll a die without opening a character sheet.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.08: The Combat Tracker can roll and sort initiative automatically.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.09: Right-click and drag to pan the canvas, and scroll the mouse wheel to zoom.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.10: Macros on the hotbar can automate rolls, chat messages and more.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.11: Ambient light and sound sources bring a scene to life beyond the map art.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.12: Click a roll in the chat to expand the details of every die.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.13: Vision and darkvision ranges are set per token, not per scene.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.14: Moving a scene into a folder only reorganises the sidebar; existing links keep working.
ULTLS.SeedTips.Foundry.15: Module settings often hide small quality-of-life options worth a look.
ULTLS.Settings.EnabledGM.Name: Show for the Game Master
ULTLS.Settings.EnabledGM.Hint: Display the loading screen in the Game Master's own browser when they enter the world.
ULTLS.Settings.EnabledPlayers.Name: Show for players
ULTLS.Settings.EnabledPlayers.Hint: Display the loading screen in the browsers of all connected players.
ULTLS.Settings.AllowPlayerTheme.Name: Let players choose their own theme
ULTLS.Settings.AllowPlayerTheme.Hint: When on, each player can pick their own colours, fonts, progress style and icon for the loading screen (from the module settings or the token controls). It only changes what that player sees. Timing, tips, the sound file, the background and the scene rules stay under your control.
ULTLS.Settings.SimpleMode.Name: Simple mode (this device)
ULTLS.Settings.SimpleMode.Hint: Disables animations, blur and glow. Use this on slower devices or weak connections. It applies only to this device, and can also be toggled from the token controls.
ULTLS.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
ULTLS.Settings.Debug.Hint: Write detailed messages to the browser console (F12) during loading, including the final resolved file paths. Turn this on when a background, icon or sound does not appear.
ULTLS.Settings.SceneMode.Name: Scene targeting
ULTLS.Settings.SceneMode.Hint: "All scenes" always shows the screen. "Selected scenes only" shows it only when the user enters one of the chosen scenes. "All except selected" is the reverse — everywhere but those scenes. The scene list is set below.
ULTLS.Settings.SceneMode.Except: All scenes except the selected ones
ULTLS.Settings.SlowSceneEnabled.Name: Show on slow scenes too
ULTLS.Settings.SlowSceneEnabled.Hint: The scene filter above hides the screen during play, but a heavy map still means a real wait. When enabled, the loading screen appears anyway if a scene takes too long to draw — the filter is ignored in that case, because the wait is real.
ULTLS.Settings.SlowScene.Name: Slow-scene threshold (ms)
ULTLS.Settings.SlowScene.Hint: If a scene takes longer than this to finish drawing, the loading screen appears regardless of the scene filter above.
ULTLS.Settings.MinDuration.Name: Minimum screen time (ms)
ULTLS.Settings.MinDuration.Hint: The loading screen stays visible at least this long, even if the world loads instantly. The default of 4000 matches the intended 4-second minimum.
ULTLS.Settings.MaxDuration.Name: Maximum screen time (ms)
ULTLS.Settings.MaxDuration.Hint: The simulated load is given a random duration between the minimum and this value, so the screen never feels identical twice.
ULTLS.Settings.Hold.Name: Final hold (ms)
ULTLS.Settings.Hold.Hint: After loading completes, the finished progress is held for about this long before fading out. The actual wait is randomised slightly (±20%) so it never feels mechanical.
ULTLS.Settings.Safety.Name: Safety timeout (ms)
ULTLS.Settings.Safety.Hint: If the world still has not reported itself ready after this long, the screen closes itself so nobody gets stuck. Set to 0 to disable.
ULTLS.Settings.TipInterval.Name: Default tip display time (ms)
ULTLS.Settings.TipInterval.Hint: How long a tip stays on screen unless it has its own time. Set a time for one tip, or for all of them at once, on the Tips tab.
ULTLS.Settings.ProgressStyle.Name: Progress style
ULTLS.Settings.ProgressStyle.Hint: How the progress is drawn: a continuous bar, discrete blocks, a circular ring, a row of dots, or a dashed trail with a travelling spark.
ULTLS.Settings.ProgressPosition.Name: Progress position
ULTLS.Settings.ProgressPosition.Hint: Where the progress element sits on screen. Centre is the classic full loading screen; a bottom corner gives a subtler, in-game feel.
ULTLS.Settings.TipPosition.Name: Tip position
ULTLS.Settings.TipPosition.Hint: Where the tips appear, using the same seven screen zones as the progress element. When both are in the same zone they merge into one box (see "Merged tip order"). "Hidden" turns the tips off.
ULTLS.Settings.TipMergedOrder.Name: Merged tip order
ULTLS.Settings.TipMergedOrder.Hint: When the tips and the progress element share the same zone, they merge into a single box. This controls whether the tip sits above or below the progress inside that box.
ULTLS.Settings.ShowPanel.Name: Show panel frame
ULTLS.Settings.ShowPanel.Hint: On: the progress sits in a bordered panel. Off: the panel disappears and the progress floats directly over the background — the cinematic look.
ULTLS.Settings.EdgePadding.Name: Edge padding
ULTLS.Settings.EdgePadding.Hint: Distance from the screen edges, in percent of the viewport. Only noticeable when the progress is not centred.
ULTLS.Settings.BarThickness.Name: Progress thickness (px)
ULTLS.Settings.BarThickness.Hint: Height of the bar or of the blocks. Also affects the thickness of the ring and of the dots.
ULTLS.Settings.TrailCometLength.Name: Comet tail length (%)
ULTLS.Settings.TrailCometLength.Hint: Only affects the "Dashed trail" style. How long the glowing tail behind the travelling spark is, as a share of the track's width. Higher values read as a longer comet; lower values as a short, tight spark.
ULTLS.Settings.ShowPercent.Name: Show percentage
ULTLS.Settings.ShowPercent.Hint: Display the numeric progress value. With the circular ring the number is drawn in the centre of the ring instead.
ULTLS.Settings.ShowStage.Name: Show loading stage
ULTLS.Settings.ShowStage.Hint: Display the stage text describing what is being loaded.
ULTLS.Settings.ShowTips.Name: Show tips
ULTLS.Settings.ShowTips.Hint: Display the tips. The tips themselves are edited on the Tips tab.
ULTLS.Settings.TitleText.Name: Title text
ULTLS.Settings.TitleText.Hint: Optional heading shown above the progress. Leave empty to hide it.
ULTLS.Settings.PrimaryFontFamily.Name: Primary font family
ULTLS.Settings.PrimaryFontFamily.Hint: Font used for the title, stage text and percentage, picked from fonts already installed in this Foundry world (via core, other modules, or Foundry's Font Configuration). "Default" keeps the module's built-in font.
ULTLS.Settings.PrimaryFontSize.Name: Primary font size (%)
ULTLS.Settings.PrimaryFontSize.Hint: Scales the title, stage text and percentage together, relative to their normal size. 100% changes nothing.
ULTLS.Settings.PrimaryFontWeight.Name: Primary font weight
ULTLS.Settings.PrimaryFontWeight.Hint: Overrides how bold the title, stage text and percentage are. "Default" leaves each element's own weight alone.
ULTLS.Settings.PrimaryFontStyle.Name: Primary font style
ULTLS.Settings.PrimaryFontStyle.Hint: Overrides italics for the title, stage text and percentage. "Default" leaves each element's own style alone.
ULTLS.Settings.TipsFontFamily.Name: Tips font family
ULTLS.Settings.TipsFontFamily.Hint: Font used for the lore & game tips, picked from fonts already installed in this Foundry world, independently from the title and progress text. "Default" keeps the module's built-in font.
ULTLS.Settings.TipsFontSize.Name: Tips font size (%)
ULTLS.Settings.TipsFontSize.Hint: Scales the tip text relative to its normal size. 100% changes nothing.
ULTLS.Settings.TipsFontWeight.Name: Tips font weight
ULTLS.Settings.TipsFontWeight.Hint: Overrides how bold the tip text is. "Default" leaves it alone.
ULTLS.Settings.TipsFontStyle.Name: Tips font style
ULTLS.Settings.TipsFontStyle.Hint: Overrides italics for the tip text. Tips read as italic by default; "Default" keeps that.
ULTLS.Settings.PaletteTheme.Name: Theme
ULTLS.Settings.PaletteTheme.Hint: A starting point: choosing a theme sets the colours, both font groups and the progress style in one go. Each of those stays an ordinary setting afterwards, free to adjust.
ULTLS.Settings.OverlayBg.Name: Backdrop — colour 1
ULTLS.Settings.OverlayBg.Hint: Primary colour of the gradient behind the loading panel.
ULTLS.Settings.OverlayBg2.Name: Backdrop — colour 2
ULTLS.Settings.OverlayBg2.Hint: Secondary colour of the gradient behind the loading panel.
ULTLS.Settings.OverlayOpacity.Name: Backdrop opacity (%)
ULTLS.Settings.OverlayOpacity.Hint: How opaque the gradient backdrop is. Lower values let a background image read clearly — 0 to 30 works well with artwork.
ULTLS.Settings.BarFill.Name: Progress fill
ULTLS.Settings.BarFill.Hint: Colour of the filled part of the progress element.
ULTLS.Settings.BarTrack.Name: Progress track
ULTLS.Settings.BarTrack.Hint: Colour of the empty part behind the fill.
ULTLS.Settings.Border.Name: Border colour
ULTLS.Settings.Border.Hint: Colour of the panel and progress outlines.
ULTLS.Settings.PrimaryText.Name: Primary text colour
ULTLS.Settings.AccentText.Name: Accent text colour
ULTLS.Settings.AccentText.Hint: Colour of the title, the stage text and the tips.
ULTLS.Settings.IconColor.Name: Icon colour
ULTLS.Settings.IconColor.Hint: Colour of the icon when a Font Awesome glyph is used. Has no effect on a custom image.
ULTLS.Settings.GlowColor.Name: Glow colour
ULTLS.Settings.GlowColor.Hint: Colour of the ambient glow, progress glow and shadows.
ULTLS.Settings.BackgroundImage.Name: Background image
ULTLS.Settings.BackgroundImage.Hint: A path to a file, not the image itself. Pick it with the folder button rather than typing. WEBP or JPG. Make sure the folder holding it is registered in File Sources.
ULTLS.Settings.BackgroundDim.Name: Background dimming (%)
ULTLS.Settings.BackgroundDim.Hint: How much the background image is darkened so text stays readable. At 0 the image shows as-is.
ULTLS.Settings.IconMode.Name: Icon source
ULTLS.Settings.IconMode.Hint: "Automatic" uses the image when one is set, otherwise the glyph. Recommended — it avoids forgetting to switch modes.
ULTLS.Settings.IconFA.Name: Font Awesome class
ULTLS.Settings.IconFA.Hint: The icon classes, for example "fa-solid fa-dice-d20". Used when the source is Font Awesome, or Automatic with no image set.
ULTLS.Settings.IconImage.Name: Icon image
ULTLS.Settings.IconImage.Hint: Path to a PNG, SVG or WEBP file used as the icon. With the source set to "Automatic" it is enough to set the path here. A PNG with a transparent background works best.
ULTLS.Settings.IconSize.Name: Icon size (%)
ULTLS.Settings.IconSize.Hint: Scales the icon relative to its normal size, whether it is a Font Awesome glyph or a custom image.
ULTLS.Settings.IconOffsetX.Name: Icon offset — horizontal (px)
ULTLS.Settings.IconOffsetX.Hint: Nudges the icon left (negative) or right (positive) from its normal spot, without affecting the layout around it.
ULTLS.Settings.IconOffsetY.Name: Icon offset — vertical (px)
ULTLS.Settings.IconOffsetY.Hint: Nudges the icon up (negative) or down (positive) from its normal spot, without affecting the layout around it.
ULTLS.Settings.IconSpin.Name: Spinning icon
ULTLS.Settings.IconSpin.Hint: Rotates the icon continuously, like a classic loading spinner. Works with any icon source.
ULTLS.Settings.IconSpinSpeed.Name: Spin duration (seconds per turn)
ULTLS.Settings.IconSpinSpeed.Hint: How long one full rotation takes. Lower is faster.
ULTLS.Settings.IconPulse.Name: Pulsing icon
ULTLS.Settings.IconPulse.Hint: Makes the icon breathe — grow and shrink gently, on a loop. Combines fine with spinning.
ULTLS.Settings.IconPulseSpeed.Name: Pulse duration (seconds per cycle)
ULTLS.Settings.IconPulseSpeed.Hint: How long one grow-and-shrink cycle takes. Lower is faster.
ULTLS.Settings.IconPulseAmount.Name: Pulse strength (%)
ULTLS.Settings.IconPulseAmount.Hint: How much larger the icon gets at the peak of each pulse.
ULTLS.Settings.SoundPath.Name: Loading sound
ULTLS.Settings.SoundPath.Hint: An audio file that plays while the loading screen is up. Pick it with the folder button; leave it empty for no sound. Browsers may block sound until the first click on the page — then it starts after that click.
ULTLS.Settings.SoundVolume.Name: Sound volume (%)
ULTLS.Settings.SoundVolume.Hint: Volume of the loading sound. Foundry's own Interface volume slider is applied on top, so a player who mutes interface sounds also mutes this one. Players can lower it for themselves in their personal theme.
ULTLS.Settings.SoundLoop.Name: Repeat the sound
ULTLS.Settings.SoundLoop.Hint: Repeats the file until loading is finished. Turn it off for a short jingle that should play once.
ULTLS.Settings.SoundFadeIn.Name: Fade-in (ms)
ULTLS.Settings.SoundFadeIn.Hint: How long the sound takes to reach full volume when it starts.
ULTLS.Settings.SoundFadeOut.Name: Fade-out (ms)
ULTLS.Settings.SoundFadeOut.Hint: How long the sound takes to fade to silence when the loading screen closes. It may keep fading for a moment after the screen has gone.
ULTLS.Settings.TipOrder.Name: Tip order
ULTLS.Settings.TipOrder.Hint: Whether tips are shown in the order you wrote them, or shuffled randomly.
ULTLS.Settings.ConflictAction.Name: On module conflict
ULTLS.Settings.ConflictAction.Hint: What to do when another module that also replaces the loading screen is active.
ULTLS.Settings.ExtraConflictIds.Name: Extra conflict ids
ULTLS.Settings.ExtraConflictIds.Hint: Additional module ids to treat as conflicting, separated by spaces or commas. Prefix an id with ! to remove it from the built-in list.
